title: Anthony Morris to James Monroe, Cadiz/Madrid 1813-15: the State Department code (the JQA table, the = 1385) with its sixteen blocks in reverse order; frame 0039 read in part (catalogue 650)

documents.shelfmark: NARA RG 59, Despatches from US Ministers to Spain vol. 12, microfilm M31 roll 14 (naId 188606645), frame 0039, page headed '4' (catalogue 650)

plaintext.source: No contemporary decipherment on the frame or in the OCR of the neighbouring frames (catalogue 650). A few phrases are written in clear among the groups (lines 1-6).

transcription.source: NARA M31 roll 14 frame 0039 (full frame and enlarged crops)
transcription.notes: 26 written lines. 554 groups (552 numbers 1-1600, one group 5127 out of range, one group cut by the frame edge), counted by decode.py (groups joined by dots are counted one by one; python docs/_check_profile.py --measure counts words, not groups). Lines 1-6 and 10-12 read in a first pass, the rest in a second. A second agent re-read 144 groups blind (lines 3, 7, 9, 13, 18, 24 in full, parts of 12 and 17): 140 agree. Its three clear corrections (L9 721 for 724, L9 13 for 131, L24 608 for 108) are applied; L24 518 may be 548. About 74% of the groups were read once only.

system.summary: The State Department's numerical syllable-and-word code (the JQA table, the = 1385, about 1,600 numbers, rebuilt in ../jqa), in Morris's copy with its sixteen blocks of 100 numbered in reverse order: Morris 100*i + r = JQA 100*(15 - i) + r, each block keeping its inner order (the = 285, of = 76).
system.sibling_key: the JQA code, ../jqa/code_table.tsv (rebuilt there from the State Department clerk's decodes and Ford's printed decipherments of JQA's 1811-1812 despatches), applied unchanged under the block order in block_map.tsv
system.notes: distinct_symbols = distinct numbers in morris1813_transcription.txt (decode.py). Groups are joined by dots within a word and separated by a space between words. Marks under groups (5, 55, 5555, c, s) and a short double stroke after groups are transcribed; their meaning is not known. 361 and 364 (= JQA 1261, 1264) behave as comma and full stop, as in the Ellis 1839 alignment (open PR #107).

prior_solution.where: None found: the catalogue calls the code unidentified; no decipherment on the frame; one web search found no printed decipherment. Not checked: W. R. Manning, Diplomatic Correspondence of the United States concerning the Independence of the Latin-American Nations (1925) vol. 3, part XIII 'Communications from Spain', which may print the despatch in clear if the Department deciphered it; C. Woolfley, A Quaker Goes to Spain (2012/13), and the Anthony Morris family papers at the Historical Society of Pennsylvania, which may hold Morris's drafts in clear.

conditions.human_role: WAINUT set the task (catalogue 650) and the rules; the AI agents fetched the frames, transcribed, matched the tables, decoded, read and verified. No target-specific human intervention.

solution.what: WAINUT contribution: NARA M31 roll 14 frames 0036-0039 fetched; frame 0039 (page '4', code with clear phrases in lines 1-6) chosen to work on.
WAINUT contribution: frame 0039 transcribed from the full frame and enlarged crops, lines 1-6 and 10-12 first, then lines 7-9 and 13-26: 554 groups in 26 lines.

WAINUT contribution: 220 number-to-value tables from the repository (main and open WAINUT pull requests) applied directly to the groups and scored on function words: none fits (best function-word share 0.11).

WAINUT contribution: constant shifts of the group numbers, with and without a modulus, against the US tables: the JQA table at +1100 stands out (function-word share 0.25 against 0.03 for the next tables) because one block of 100 lines up.

WAINUT contribution: best JQA offset for each Morris block of 100: the busy blocks give +1500, +1300, +1100 (Morris 1-300), which suggests the sixteen blocks in reverse order (block_map.tsv); the first round overstated this as a clean pattern in every block. On the corrected transcription function words alone pick that block for 8 of 16 Morris blocks (1-300, 401-500, 601-700, 801-1100); the other eight follow from the pattern and from context.

WAINUT contribution: a second agent re-read 144 groups blind from the image (140 agree) and re-applied the method with its own code. The three clear misreadings it found (L9 724 -> 721 dem, L9 131 -> 13 ad, L24 108 -> 608 or) each turn a broken syllable into the expected one (democratic, administration, ambassador). It corrected overstated counts of the first round: 76.285 'of the' 15x (not 25x); 'territory' and 'insurrection' 2x each as identical group strings (not 3x).

WAINUT contribution: decode.py --controls on the 552 groups: block_map.tsv coverage 0.917, function words 0.353; identity 0.630 / 0.058; 20,000 random orders of the 16 blocks: function words median 0.062, 99.9th percentile 0.250, max 0.297. Per block, against word bigrams of Ford, Writings of JQA vols 3-4, the block_map.tsv block ranks first (one tie) for 15 of 16 Morris blocks; Morris 1501-1600 ranks second (3 bigrams against 4) and is kept from the pattern and from context (should, United States, Minister).

WAINUT contribution: frame 0039 written out as sentences (morris1813_reading.md): 506 of 554 groups have a table value; read_share 0.678 (research/reading_audit/v2_score.py hole rate 0.322); 670 read [?Floridas] from context at all five occurrences; names Jefferson, Madison, Baton Rouge from the table syllables.

WAINUT contribution: one web search and two by the verifier found no printed decipherment and no record of the code with reversed blocks. Manning (1925) vol. 3, Woolfley and the HSP Morris papers not checked.

outcome.method: read after matching with key from external sources
outcome.method_basis: The JQA code table (../jqa/code_table.tsv), rebuilt in targets/jqa for JQA's 1811-1812 St Petersburg despatches and not tied to Morris, found here to fit Morris's groups once his sixteen blocks of 100 are taken in reverse order (block_map.tsv, recovered from the ciphertext).
outcome.fraction_read_source: morris1813_reading.md: research/reading_audit/v2_score.py hole rate 0.322 (every [n], [?word] and supplied letter counted as a hole). 506 of 554 groups (0.913) have a value in the table under block_map.tsv (decode.py).

texts.label: Morris to Monroe, M31 roll 14 frame 0039 (page '4'), catalogue 650
texts.summary: A page from the middle of a despatch about Spain's Floridas: a British offer 'last year' to send [troops] there 'under the [pretext] of preserving the territory to Spain, but probably with the intention of holding it'; a change in the Regency once the Cortes are organized; the 'democratic government of the United States under the administration of the Frenchified Señor Jefferson [and] Madison'; the separation of Spain's colonies; the insurrection of [West?] Florida and Baton Rouge; the claim that the territory belongs to Spain and was an integral part of the Floridas; the treason of a governor and the ambassador of a revolutionary government.

reading_review.by: WAINUT (AI language-model agent, reviewed against the frame)
reading_review.note: Coherent English in stretches (lines 3-7, 9-10, 12-13, 15-17, 20-26 in part), with holes in most sentences: 32% of the words are open groups, context readings or supplied letters. A partial reading of one page, not a full one.

outcome.notes: Contributed by WAINUT (catalogue 650). Same code as ../jqa, nothing there is changed; Morris's block order is in block_map.tsv. Only frame 0039 of the despatches is worked.
